simulator.note: Boots as C3505 with chip ID 0x3821 and variant 0xC000 (chips/c3505.py): the HATK5 bootloader unpacks maincode to 0x80000200 and seecode to 0xAE000200 with 128 MB DDR3, and runs Libcore 19.17.0 with DVB-S2X and DVB-T2/C NIMs.

desc: Ferguson Ariva 160 Combo official firmware update (2025-11-26) on 8 MB SPI flash for the ALi C3505 / M3821 (chip ID 0x3821) DVB-S2X + DVB-T2/C receiver with 128 MB DDR3.
Combines internal NIM_C3501h_0 (DVB-S2X) and NIM_S3821_0 (DVB-T2/C) tuners under Libcore 19.17.0.
